title: Ezra Bridger
description: After the Empire took his parents, Ezra Bridger had to survive on the streets of Lothal by his wits alone. In a chance encounter, he met Kanan Jarrus, a former Jedi who sensed the Force in him and took him as his Padawan. He struggled with staying on his Jedi path, especially under the influence of Maul, but he remained a faithful student to Kanan. After Kanan's sacrifice to save Ezra's life, Ezra took it upon himself to save Lothal. He was able to exile Grand Admiral Thrawn to another galaxy, though he was forced into exile, too.
